value.rationale: This is a complete classification of natural Weil-isogeny invariants for every rational member of the historically important generalized Legendre plane-quartic pencil over F13. The classical S3 anharmonic branch symmetry induces three geometrically motivated orbits, each showing a precisely two-way arithmetic Weil splitting. Within the equianharmonic orbit the two distinct full Frobenius types have 28 versus 4 F13-rational points, exposing pronounced arithmetic descent behavior that rational branch configuration alone misses; it is not an arbitrary sliced invariant.
